specs.title: Flutterwave adapter
specs.why: A second provider proves the payment port is a real abstraction and unblocks other markets.
specs.scope: Second PaymentProvider implementation with tenant-level provider selection and shared contract tests.
tasks: Add `prisma/schema.prisma`: add the `paymentProvider` column to the `Tenant` model
acceptance: Both adapters pass `__tests__/payment-contract.test.ts`, verified by `pnpm test`
Ledger writes from both adapters have identical shape

specs.title: WhatsApp provider abstraction
specs.why: Every messaging feature depends on this port, and isolating it keeps the rest testable.
specs.scope: WhatsAppProvider port with a Meta Cloud API adapter and a template catalog.
specs.non_goals: Template approval and a live business number are human prerequisites; tests must use the fake adapter.
tasks: Add `app/lib/whatsapp/meta.ts`: add the adapter and a fake in `app/lib/whatsapp/fake.ts`
acceptance: A sandbox send returns HTTP 200 with a message id, verified by `pnpm test`
`app/lib/whatsapp/fake.ts` substitutes for the adapter in tests
